content: iburha lya Daudi
Aga go mazîno g’abâna ba Daudi bàburhiragwa e Hebroni. Owa burhanzi, Amnoni, mugala wa Ahinowamu w’e Yizreyeli. Owa kabirhi, Daniyeli, mugala wa Abigayili, w’e Karmeli.
Owa Kasharhu, Absalomu, mugala wa Maaka, mwâli wa Talmayi mwâmi w’e Geshuri. Owa kani, Aniya, mugala wa Hagiti.
Owa karhanu, Shefatiya, mugala wa Abitali. Owa kali ndarhu, Yitrayamu, mugala wa Egla, naye mukà mwâmi.
Aligwêrhe bâna ndarhu baburhiragwa aha Hebroni, ho àyîmaga myâka nda na myêzi ndarhu. Ashubiyîma n’aha Yeruzalemu myâka makumi a sharhu n’isharhu.
N’abà bakulikîre bo bâna bâge baburhiragwa aha Yeruzalemu: Shimeya, Shobabu, Natani, Salomoni: bâna bâni ba Bati-Shuwa, mwâli wa Amiyeli.
Yibehari, Elishamaʿ, Elifêleti,
Noga, Nefegi, Yafiya,
Elishamaʿ, Eliyada, Elifeleti; bâna mwenda.
Abo boshi bo bâna ba Daudi. Abâna b’ebiherula byâge barhaganjirwi. Abusire n’omwânanyere, ye Tamari.
Abâmi ba Yûda
Abâna ba Salomoni nk’oku banakulikiranaga, bo: Rehabamu, Abiya, Asa, Yehoshafati,
Yoramu, Akhaziyahu, Yowash,
Amaziyahu, Azaryahu, Yotamu,
Ahazi, Hizekiyahu, Menashè,
Amoni na Yoshiyahu.
Bagala ba Yoshiyahu: Yohanani lwo lubere, owa kabirhi, Yehoyakimu, owa kasharhu, Sidekiyahu, n’owa kani Shalumu.
Bagala ba Yehoyakimu, bo: Yekoniya na Sidekiyahu.
Abâna b’abâmi enyuma ly’olubungo
Bagala ba Yekoniya, olya walulizibagwa e Babiloni, bo: Sheyaltiyeli,
Malkiramu, Pedaya, Shenasari, Yekamiya, Hoshama na Nedabiya.
Bagala ba Pedaya, bo: Zorobabeli na Shimeyi. Zorobabeli aburha bagala babirhi: Meshulamu na Hananiya, na munyere muguma ye Shelomiti.
Buzinda ashubiburha bâna barhanu: Hashuba, Oheli, Berekiya, Hasadiya na Yushabu-Hesedi.
Abâna ba Hananiya, bo: Pelatiya na Yeshaya, haguma na bagala ba Refaya, bagala ba Arnoni, bagala ba Obadiya na bagala ba Shekanya.
Abâna ba Shekaniya: Shemaya, Hatushi, Yigeyali, Bariyahi, Neariya, Shafati boshi bantu ndarhu.
Abâna ba Neyariya: Eliyehoyenayi, Hizikiya, Azrikamu, boshi bantu basharhu.
Abâna ba Eliyehoyenayi, bo: Hoda­viyahu, Eliyasibu, Pelaya, Akubu, Yohanani, Delaya, Anani, boshi bantu nda.
